verdict.rationale: Twenty covers much of the UI's surface through its API. Every object, built-in or custom, gets identical REST and GraphQL endpoints with per-workspace docs, and a Metadata API can create, modify and delete objects, fields and relations. It also supports batch create/update/delete/upsert, outgoing webhooks and workflow webhook triggers, an MCP server, and apps that define objects, fields and views as code. However, the evidence never claims full UI/API parity, and many UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: API management of views/kanban/filters, dashboards and widgets, workflow authoring, roles/permissions and email/calendar connection settings; an explicit parity statement; and independent hands-on confirmation beyond one user saying the REST API 'worked ok'.
